This worksheet records observed use. Fictional scenarios and software checks do not count as participants. Records stay in this browser until you export them.

Before a session
  • Use a participant code, not a name or email. Obtain the appropriate parent/student permission before collecting notes.
  • Keep the student’s saved guide in their own browser/account. This worksheet does not read or copy their answers.
  • Ask for the student’s initial interests before they see recommendations. Include mixed interests, low confidence, unfamiliar activities and differing education preferences.
  • Use real choices for the student’s guide. Use fictional amounts for any financial experiment they prefer not to disclose.
Guidance review

First-round review targets: no lost notes, no dead ends, every student can name one next action, and students can distinguish interest alignment from qualification and modeled pay. Report actual denominators; investigate each failure. These are product review targets, not validated psychometric cutoffs.
